diagnostic_code_classification.reason: Public later-stage methods require an attached match before reading the environment, and match commits the environment atomically; only corrupted internal builder state can reach this integrity diagnostic.
Public binding handles are opaque and builder-created; foreign handles fail owner identity before their dense authored ID can be looked up.
The builder derives the dense map from the exact root or local scope it is lowering; public opaque handles cannot forge an authored ID outside that scope map.

needles: "every declared binding must be referenced by a pattern"
diagnostic_code_classification.reason: Unscoped public declarations are omitted at finalization, while root/local scope claims are derived from pattern references and local consumed-equals-referenced checks; only direct plan construction can retain an unused declared binding.
The public builder lowers against one immutable QueryAuthority whose resolved and managed declaration identities are paired at construction; the mismatch is a direct validation-state integrity check.

needles: "a hidden witness must be positively established in its lexical scope"
diagnostic_code_classification.reason: Public scope claims come from validated pattern references and reject unbound negation, try, and local references earlier; a non-positive hidden scoped witness requires a forged direct plan.
Every public local function consumes at least one unique authored binding, so the 256 authored-binding ceiling rejects the 257th required binding before a 257th local function can be formed.
Public finalization always attaches the managed semantic fingerprint from the same immutable authority used for validation; only direct or decoded plan bytes can carry a different fingerprint.
The public builder exposes match as the only first-stage transition and reports query_builder_match_required or query_plan_stage_order before any later stage can precede it.

needles: "links role is not effective on the declared relation"
diagnostic_code_classification.reason: Python and Node links authoring qualify every role through query_builder_role_players with the same relation label supplied to the links pattern; a mismatched role relation exists only at the direct Rust/contract boundary.
Input operands are opaque handles returned only by input declarations on the same builder, and owner validation prevents foreign handles; an unknown dense input ID requires direct plan construction.

direct_wire_only.reason: Public host rows are untagged and are converted against the declared input domain; a forged canonical scalar tag exists only at the Rust/wire boundary.

non_applicable.reason: N-API class instances and their private native external are isolate-bound and are not transferable through the worker structured-clone boundary; no public Node call can invoke one builder instance from a foreign isolate thread.
